breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a conflicting instruction to use both a gamma-centered k-point grid and a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh. The ground truth resolved this by removing the mention of the half shift. The agent's generated specification also correctly resolved this conflict by specifying a 'gamma-centered Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid', which correctly drops the contradictory 'half shift' instruction, aligning with the ground truth's approach.
